notes: Quote email fixes. It now opens with “Please find my quote below for…” rather than thanking them for getting in touch, with a dropdown if it really is a cold enquiry. The crew row names you instead of reading as though the client is on the vision mixer. Add-ons can be passed through at cost without the app pushing a markup. The whole-run discount can invite them to add more dates for a bigger saving. The quote date now shows in words under the box, with a Today button. Tighter margins around the email.
